registers.name: CTRL

fields.name: enable
fields.description: Enables firmware-mediated request issuance and validated actuator update path.

fields.name: request_mode
fields.description: Selects request issuance mode used by the request/response supervisor.

fields.name: overwrite_policy
fields.description: 0 selects stall-on-outstanding-request; 1 permits overwrite with explicit indication.

fields.name: rate_limit_enable
fields.description: Enables optional actuator rate-of-change limiting.

fields.name: clear_faults
fields.description: Firmware request to clear latched faults when the underlying condition has cleared.

registers.write_semantics: Writes update control bits synchronously; clear_faults is interpreted as a pulse-style request bit by RTL.
registers.read_semantics: Reads return the current control state and reserved bits as zero.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES

fields.name: timeout_cycles
fields.description: Maximum cycles allowed between request issuance and matching validated response.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.write_semantics: Programmable watchdog timeout; values of zero are treated as implementation-safe minimum or hold-off according to RTL behavior.
registers.read_semantics: Returns the programmed timeout value.

registers.name: FRESHNESS_THRESHOLD
registers.description: Maximum acceptable response age in cycles/age units as interpreted by RTL.

fields.name: freshness_threshold
fields.description: Upper bound on acceptable response age for validation.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.write_semantics: Sets the response freshness acceptance threshold.
registers.read_semantics: Returns the programmed freshness threshold.

registers.name: SEQUENCE_CFG
registers.description: Sequence seed and current request sequence control.

fields.name: sequence_seed
fields.description: Seed used to initialize or rebase sequence tracking.

fields.name: request_seq
fields.description: Current request sequence programmed by firmware and placed into outbound request packets.

registers.write_semantics: Firmware can seed or explicitly set the next request sequence.
registers.read_semantics: Returns seed and current request sequence.

registers.name: REQUEST_CLASS
registers.description: Command class identifier for the external model request.

fields.name: request_class
fields.description: Fixed-slice command class identifier encoded into the request packet.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.write_semantics: Selects the semantic class of the external model request.
registers.read_semantics: Returns the configured request class.

registers.name: GEOMETRY_REF
registers.description: Geometry reference tag or hash pointer; no geometry tensor is exposed.

fields.name: geometry_ref
fields.description: Opaque reference or hash pointer used only as a bounded packet field and validation input.

registers.write_semantics: Writes an opaque geometry reference token.
registers.read_semantics: Returns the configured geometry reference token.

registers.name: OP_POINT_MIN

fields.name: op_point_min_kph
fields.description: Minimum valid operating-point speed in km/h (firmware may scale from m/s as needed).

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.write_semantics: Sets the lower accepted operating-point envelope bound.
registers.read_semantics: Returns the configured lower bound.

registers.name: OP_POINT_MAX

fields.name: op_point_max_kph
fields.description: Maximum valid operating-point speed in km/h (firmware may scale from m/s as needed).

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.write_semantics: Sets the upper accepted operating-point envelope bound.
registers.read_semantics: Returns the configured upper bound.

registers.name: SURFACE0_LIMITS

fields.name: surface0_min
fields.description: Lower clamp bound for actuator surface 0.

fields.name: surface0_max
fields.description: Upper clamp bound for actuator surface 0.

registers.write_semantics: Programs min/max clamp bounds for surface 0.
registers.read_semantics: Returns min/max bounds for surface 0.

registers.name: SURFACE1_LIMITS

fields.name: surface1_min
fields.description: Lower clamp bound for actuator surface 1.

fields.name: surface1_max
fields.description: Upper clamp bound for actuator surface 1.

registers.write_semantics: Programs min/max clamp bounds for surface 1.
registers.read_semantics: Returns min/max bounds for surface 1.

registers.name: SURFACE2_LIMITS

fields.name: surface2_min
fields.description: Lower clamp bound for actuator surface 2.

fields.name: surface2_max
fields.description: Upper clamp bound for actuator surface 2.

registers.write_semantics: Programs min/max clamp bounds for surface 2.
registers.read_semantics: Returns min/max bounds for surface 2.

registers.name: SURFACE3_LIMITS

fields.name: surface3_min
fields.description: Lower clamp bound for actuator surface 3.

fields.name: surface3_max
fields.description: Upper clamp bound for actuator surface 3.

registers.write_semantics: Programs min/max clamp bounds for surface 3.
registers.read_semantics: Returns min/max bounds for surface 3.

registers.name: RATE_LIMIT

fields.name: rate_limit_step
fields.description: Maximum permitted absolute change per update when rate limiting is enabled.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.write_semantics: Sets the step limit used by optional rate limiting.
registers.read_semantics: Returns the configured rate-limit step.

registers.name: FALLBACK0

fields.name: fallback_surface0
fields.description: Deterministic safe fallback output for surface 0.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.write_semantics: Programs the safe fallback output for surface 0.
registers.read_semantics: Returns the configured fallback output for surface 0.

fields.description: Deterministic safe fallback output for surface 1.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.write_semantics: Programs the safe fallback output for surface 1.
registers.read_semantics: Returns the configured fallback output for surface 1.

registers.name: FALLBACK2

registers.name: STATUS_LAST_SEQ
registers.description: Last accepted or observed response sequence.

fields.name: last_response_sequence
fields.description: Sequence ID of the last validated or observed response.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.read_semantics: Returns the last response sequence tracked by RTL.

registers.name: STATUS_LAST_AGE

fields.name: last_response_age
fields.description: Age or freshness age associated with the most recent response.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.read_semantics: Returns the last response age tracked by RTL.

registers.name: STATUS_FAULT_SUMMARY

fields.name: fault_summary
fields.description: Latched safety fault summary bits.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.read_semantics: Returns the latched fault summary.

registers.name: STATUS_HEALTH_SUMMARY

fields.name: health_summary
fields.description: Live health summary bits including CPU/runtime readiness and transport health indicators.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.read_semantics: Returns the live health summary.

registers.name: STATUS_WATCHDOG

fields.name: watchdog_active
fields.description: Indicates that the request watchdog is currently active.

fields.name: request_issued
fields.description: Indicates that a request has been issued by the supervisor.

fields.name: request_stalled
fields.description: Indicates that request issuance was stalled due to an outstanding request.

fields.name: request_overwritten
fields.description: Indicates that a new request overwrote an outstanding one per policy.

fields.name: history_valid
fields.description: Indicates that bounded history data is valid.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.read_semantics: Returns live request/watchdog state and history validity.
